{
  "candidate_rtl": "`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module pw_crc32_d16 (
    input  wire [15:0] data_in,
    input  wire [31:0] state_in,
    output wire [15:0] data_out,
    output wire [31:0] state_out
);

    // Combine paired state/data terms before distributing them to the
    // parallel CRC network.
    wire [15:0] q;
    assign q = data_in ^ state_in[15:0];

    // Constant propagation of symbolic input bits through the reflected
    // CRC32 recurrence. This function is evaluated only at elaboration.
    function [15:0] crc_mask;
        input integer index;
        reg [15:0] s [0:31];
        reg [15:0] d [0:15];
        reg [15:0] feedback;
        reg [31:0] poly;
        integer i;
        integer j;
        begin
            poly = 32'hedb88320;
            for (j = 0; j < 32; j = j + 1)
                s[j] = 16'b0;
            for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1) begin
                feedback = s[0] ^ (16'h0001 << i);
                d[i] = feedback;
                for (j = 0; j < 31; j = j + 1)
                    s[j] = s[j+1];
                s[31] = 16'b0;
                for (j = 0; j < 32; j = j + 1)
                    if (poly[j])
                        s[j] = s[j] ^ feedback;
            end
            if (index < 32)
                crc_mask = s[index];
            else
                crc_mask = d[index-32];
        end
    endfunction

    // Pack selected terms before reduction, avoiding gaps in the parity
    // operands and exposing a compact, balanced parallel XOR expression.
    function [15:0] pack_terms;
        input [15:0] value;
        input [15:0] mask;
        integer i;
        integer count;
        begin
            pack_terms = 16'b0;
            count = 0;
            for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1) begin
                if (mask[i]) begin
                    pack_terms[count] = value[i];
                    count = count + 1;
                end
            end
        end
    endfunction

    genvar n;
    generate
        for (n = 0; n < 32; n = n + 1) begin : state_bits
            localparam [15:0] MASK = crc_mask(n);
            wire parity;
            assign parity = ^pack_terms(q, MASK);
            if (n < 16) begin : shifted_state
                assign state_out[n] = parity ^ state_in[n+16];
            end else begin : crc_only
                assign state_out[n] = parity;
            end
        end
        for (n = 0; n < 16; n = n + 1) begin : data_bits
            localparam [15:0] MASK = crc_mask(32+n);
            assign data_out[n] = ^pack_terms(q, MASK);
        end
    endgenerate

endmodule

`default_nettype wire
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline distributes individual state and data bits into wide parity networks. Its reported critical paths include substantial input buffering followed by several mapped logic stages. Duplicated state/data parity terms increase both network width and input loading.",
  "rewrite": "Factor each matching low-state/data pair into q[i] = state_in[i] XOR data_in[i]. Generate constant masks for the reflected CRC32 transformation over these 16 combined inputs, then compute compact parallel parity reductions. Add the untouched upper-state contribution only to state_out[15:0]. Generate data_out separately from the exact per-step feedback masks, rather than substituting input data or final-state bits.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The factored network reduces parity operand counts and removes direct distribution of both members of each input pair throughout the CRC matrix. This is intended to lower maximum arrival relative to 1.06 ns. Exact improvement is mapping-dependent; no candidate STA or electrical results are available.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Adds 16 shared input XORs while removing repeated paired state/data terms from the output parity networks. Expected to reduce total logic area and input buffering, although the combined q signals have appreciable fanout. Compliance with the 6203.074240 um2 cap and electrical limits requires mapped evaluation.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the parameterless pw_crc32_d16 module and all unsigned port widths. Implements exactly 16 LSB-first Galois CRC32 steps with reflected polynomial 32'hedb88320, corresponding to the reference polynomial 32'h04c11db7 with REVERSE=1. Both outputs retain their reference meaning for arbitrary binary data_in and arbitrary 32-bit state_in, without initialization, final inversion, assumptions, state, or latency. All symbolic arrays are elaboration-time function temporaries; no memories or latches are inferred."
}
